evals.prompt: Write a plan for creating a new FastAPI app to reset user passwords. This is a new FastAPI web app (not an existing codebase). We already have an existing User model (email: EmailStr, password_hash: str) and an in-memory user store to follow. We also have a preliminary endpoint spec: POST /auth/password-reset with body {"user_email": "string"}. This is an eval run, do not ask questions, proceed with your recommendations.
evals.expected_output: Agent produces a plan saved to a prefixed file (<prefix>-plan.md) with the prefix clearly related to the feature, with ACs defined before tasks, each task containing category, type, and AC mapping, each task having a clear definition of done, and each AC having a clear eval to exercise the app and capture behavior (not just 'tests pass').
expectations: A <prefix>-plan.md file exists and the prefix is related to the password reset feature
ACs are defined in the plan before tasks
Each task contains category, type, and AC mapping (via Satisfies field)
Each task has a clear definition of done
Each AC has a clear eval to exercise the app and capture behavior (runtime evidence), not just 'tests pass'
